prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1390; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, but I understand you need it. I'll go along with it.

Q: That's fine, we can note that the name is on file. Can you describe what happened on the day of the collision?

A: I was driving through an intersection in Katy, Texas, and I was turning left. The light had been green, and I started my turn when I saw a car come through the opposite lane. It hit the front driver's side of my vehicle.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I looked, but it came up fast. I think the driver was probably going faster than the limit.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt, and did your airbags deploy?

A: Yes, I had my seatbelt on. The airbags did deploy, mostly the front ones.

Q: Did you receive any injuries?

A: Yes, my left knee hit the dashboard and it's been swollen and painful since. I went to urgent care that evening. They took X-rays and told me to see an orthopedic doctor because they thought there might be ligament damage.

Q: Have you seen that doctor yet?

A: I have an appointment next week. I've been using crutches for a few days and I can't drive much because of the pain.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm worried about the repair costs and about being out of work. I'd like to know what the next steps are.

Q: We'll follow up with you on those items. Thank you for your time today.
